name: Photo mosaic resolve
oneLiner: the camera starts tight on a wall of tiny tiles cut from the brand's own screens, pulls back in log space until the tiles tint into one big picture (the author's face by default), then a diagonal wave flips every tile to its piece of the real photo and the seams close into one image under a sheen
say: when the speaker says what something is made of ('every one of these videos made me', 'this channel is built from 300 uploads', 'you are the people behind it'): cut in on the noun, the flip wave lands as they finish the sentence
